faq.description: Here are the most common questions from businesses and professionals looking to build a strategic, professional digital presence designed to create new opportunities.
faq.imageAlt: Rafaela Rodrigues reviewing a digital project in her office

imageCard.label: Consultative approach
imageCard.title: Clear communication and support throughout every stage.

questions.question: How long does it take to develop a project?
questions.answer: The timeline depends on the type of solution, the number of pages, the required features and how quickly the project materials are provided. After our initial meeting and project definition, you will receive a clear schedule covering every stage.

questions.question: Can I request changes during development?
questions.answer: Yes. Every project includes review stages so you can follow the progress and request the planned adjustments before publication.

questions.question: Do I need to have all the texts and images ready?
questions.answer: Not necessarily. During the planning stage, we organize all the content required for your project. You can provide the materials you already have, and I will guide you on what still needs to be prepared.

questions.question: Do you handle domain registration and hosting setup?
questions.answer: I can guide you through the domain and hosting purchase process, configure the necessary services and prepare everything for a secure project launch.

questions.question: Will my website work on smartphones and tablets?
questions.answer: Yes. Every project is fully responsive and developed to provide an excellent browsing experience on desktops, tablets and mobile devices.

questions.question: Can my project be developed in multiple languages?
questions.answer: Yes. Rodrigues Digital develops multilingual projects in Portuguese, English and Spanish. The project scope and investment depend on the number of languages and the amount of content to be adapted.

questions.question: Will my project include initial Google optimization?
questions.answer: Yes. Projects can include initial SEO best practices such as page structure, metadata, content organization, performance optimization and technical improvements for search engines.

questions.question: Will I receive support after the project is delivered?
questions.answer: Yes. After launch, you receive guidance on how to use your new digital solution as well as the initial support included in the project. You may also choose a monthly maintenance plan for updates, backups, monitoring and minor improvements.
